# Inventory Write-Off (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Inventory Write-Off` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 5 actions on 2 resources, 3 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-inventorywriteofflist) | `GET /inventoryWriteOffList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}` |
| [GET](#get-inventorywriteoff) | `GET /inventoryWriteOff?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-inventorywriteoff) | `POST /inventoryWriteOff` |
| [PUT](#put-inventorywriteoff) | `PUT /inventoryWriteOff` |
| [DELETE](#delete-inventorywriteoff) | `DELETE /inventoryWriteOff?ID={ID}&Void={Void}` |


## Inventory Write-Off List

Path: `/inventoryWriteOffList`

### Available fields for Inventory Write-Off List
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |          |  Unique ID.        |
| `InventoryWriteOffNumber`  | String           |         |          |Inventory Write-Off Number        |
| `Status`  | String           |         |          |Inventory Write-Off Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         |          |Location ID    |
| `Location`  | String           |         |          |Location Name     |
| `Date`  | DateTime           |         |          |Date  When Task Created.  |
| `Notes`  | String           |         |          |Notes        |

<a id="get-inventorywriteofflist"></a>
### GET /inventoryWriteOffList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100. (Default: 100)
- `Status` (optional): Only return Inventory Write-Off with specified status (Default: null)
- `Search` (optional): Only return Inventory Write-Off with search value contained in one of these fields: InventoryWriteOffNumber, Location, Status, Notes (Default: null)

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 5,
  "Page": 1,
  "InventoryWriteOffs": [
    {
      "TaskID": "97a2a4d4-7130-4281-becc-c319f0ecf67d",
      "InventoryWriteOffNumber": "FG-00028",
      "Status": "DRAFT",
      "LocationID": "19aeca31-bd49-4fbe-8abd-37a6169cc2cb",
      "Location": "Main Warehouse",
      "Date": "2018-01-12T07:29:33.457Z",
      "Notes": "Test"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Inventory Write-Off

Path: `/inventoryWriteOff`

### Available fields for Inventory Write-Off
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |          |  Unique ID.        |
| `InventoryWriteOffNumber`  | String           |         |          |Inventory Write-Off Number        |
| `Status`  | String           |         |          |Inventory Write-Off Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         |          |Location ID    |
| `Location`  | String           |         |          |Location Name     |
| `Account`  | String           |         |          |Expense Account         |
| `EffectiveDate`  | DateTime           |         |          |Effective Date         |
| `Notes`  | String           |         |          |Notes        |
| `Lines`  |<a href="#InventoryWriteOffLineModel"><b>[] Inventory Write-Off Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `Transactions`  |<a href="#TransactionStockLineModel"><b>[] Transaction Stock Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `Errors`  |<a href="#ErrorModel"><b>[] Error Model</b></a>|         |          |If While processing `POST` or `PUT` method, some errors occurred, but task was created, this property will contain array of error messages.    |

### Available fields for POST/PUT method
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |     Yes*     |  Unique ID. Required for PUT.       |
| `Status`  | String           |         |      Yes    |Inventory Write-Off Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`, `COMPLETED`         |
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         |       Yes*   |Location ID. Required if `Location` is empty.    |
| `Location`  | Decimal           |         |          Yes*|Location Name. Required if `LocationID` is empty.     |
| `Account`  | String           |         |       Yes   |Expense Account         |
| `EffectiveDate`  | DateTime           |         |       Yes*   |Effective Date. Required if `Status` = `COMPLETED`.     |
| `Notes`  | String           |         |          |Notes        |
| `Lines`  |<a href="#InventoryWriteOffLineModel"><b>[] Inventory Write-Off Line Model</b></a>|         |          |

<a id="delete-inventorywriteoff"></a>
### DELETE /inventoryWriteOff?ID={ID}&Void={Void}

Parameters:
- `ID` (required): ID of Inventory Write-Off to Void or Undo
- `Void` (optional,boolean): Void or Undo Inventory Write-Off
  - default: false

Response 200:
